_help: Problem reports -> GitHub Issues. Deploy build/report-worker.js on Cloudflare Workers (free), then paste the worker URL here. Empty = students use 'Copy report'.

messages.title: ⚠️ New wiring for the buttons (all teams)
messages.text: Buttons on pins 12–14 can't be read by the VMX. That is why STOP looked pressed and nothing moved.
steps: 🔄 Update → ⬆ Update robot (on the robot Wi-Fi)
Connect → "Buttons are on pins 12–21" → Show me → Apply
Move the plugs on the VMX: START 8 · STOP 9 · RESET 10 · Lift servo 12 · Pusher 13 · Green 14 · Red 15

messages.title: Wheels: the robot can't find the Titan
messages.text: No wheel can move until this is fixed.
steps: Titan lights on (3.3V / 5V next to 12V IN)
CAN cable (yellow / green) plugged into VMX and Titan

messages.title: Your wheel settings are mixed up
messages.text: Three wheels are set to the same Titan port (M0). "Apply" in the message above fixes it (M0 FL · M1 FR · M2 RL · M3 RR).

_help_messages: Messages shown on the student page. to = all, or the end of the robot Wi-Fi name (Team-1). Change id to show a message again.
